0022600212.text: The Boston Celtics (7-2, second in the East and second in the Atlantic, one game back) visit the Philadelphia 76ers (9-2, first in the East and first in the Atlantic) on a two-game winning streak, with Boston 2-2 on the road this season. Philadelphia is missing Adem Bona (back, sprain), Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), while the Celtics have no players listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after splitting their 2025-26 regular-season series 2-2, and the Celtics lost 3-4 to the 76ers in the 2025-26 playoffs, including a 109-100 loss in Boston on May 2, 2026.
